source: tmp/style-import/spike/cytoscape.mjs (resolveCytoscape) through readers.mjs cx and cx2, run on 2026-10-11; each column run-length encoded as [value, count]; the labelFont of a CX2 font face naming its desktop font (FONT_NAME) is that font, as Cytoscape desktop reads it back; edge curved only where EDGE_CURVED rounds bends the edge has (#2489); labelWrapWidth (NODE_LABEL_WIDTH, CX2 NODE_LABEL_MAX_WIDTH) added from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-16; node borderOpacity (NODE_BORDER_TRANSPARENCY, CX2 NODE_BORDER_OPACITY) added from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-17; edge curved also where Cytoscape desktop fans a bundle of parallel edges (graph-io's resolver, 2026-10-17); edge fanSpacing (the curves' middle spacing desktop fans parallel edges by: the larger side of the two nodes times EDGE_STACKING_DENSITY) from graph-io's readers, 2026-10-17; edge arrowSize (EDGE_TARGET_ARROW_SIZE, else EDGE_SOURCE_ARROW_SIZE, over Cytoscape's normal 6) from graph-io's own resolver, 2026-10-17; edge curved also where the style leaves EDGE_CURVED unset, which Cytoscape defaults to true, and the edge bends or is fanned, and the fanned edges of a node pair are all but its newest, which desktop draws straight (graph-io's resolver, 2026-10-18); a HEXAGON node's height is the height Cytoscape desktop squashes it to (sqrt(3)/2 of its height inside its border), from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-18; edge bends and curved of each self-loop without handles (the two handles desktop loops it round) added from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-18; label opacities, label boxes (only with a *_LABEL_BACKGROUND_SHAPE other than NONE), label positions read whole (labelPosition, labelOffsetX/Y, labelShiftX/Y), edge label rotations, wrap widths and centered edge label places added from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-19; labelWeight of a desktop font face from its name's .bold suffix only, the style word after it unread (Cytoscape 3.10.5 FontVisualProperty.parseSerializableString), from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-10-19; the edge a node pair's fan starts from (drawn straight) is the first desktop made a view of: the newer node's outgoing edges newest first, then the older node's (SimpleNetwork.getEdgeList, DEdgeDetails.getAnchors), from graph-io's own resolver on 2026-11-01
